remarks: Your search ends here! Located on a quiet cul de sac right on the Stamford-Darien border, this bright and airy townhome has it all! Entire complex just got brand new siding. New kitchen and bathrooms, attached garage, a deck and a patio, and plenty of storage. Three levels of living space. Enter through your garage and find a finished lower walk out level with laundry room and plenty of space for a gym, office, storage, or extra guest space. Your main level of living features an open floor plan, newer kitchen with open floor plan to dining and living room and a half bath. Your third level features two spacious bedrooms and a large full bathroom. Great location- convenient to downtown Stamford, I95, train station, and Darien.
